gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi has lowercase forms that fill the line like capitals. Conthrax up top is geometric and wide-mouthed in the a, so the body can drop a size without losing its footing.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable Noto Sans Kannada rises gently from small letters to capitals. Conthrax brings bold, uniform strokes to the heading, so a little extra size on the sans body would help it hold its own.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-modi: Conthrax is geometric and clean, with a wide-mouthed a and round letters whose walls match the straight strokes. Shrink the heading and Noto Sans Modi, daylight in every curve, takes over.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-multani: Modern Noto Sans Multani stands tall, with a wide gap in the e. Conthrax does its best work as a geometric single-depth cut, while the sans body does its best carrying the words.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-newa: Wide and geometric, Conthrax traces each letter in a line of constant weight. Noto Sans Newa, modern and professional, keeps reading smooth, since its open e and tall bowls give each word room.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Crisp, geometric and strangely thin-looking, with no thinner parts at all. Make the Conthrax heading small and Noto Sans Ogham, with its wide-gapped e and tall bold-looking lowercase, would swallow it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-ol-chik: Clean Conthrax holds every curve without a swell in the middle. Noto Sans Ol Chiki does the quieter job, holding curve tails back so words read as solid blocks.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-old-hun: Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps tiny sizes legible with wide apertures. Conthrax, drawn as a stitched thread outline, can take the big sizes, so let the plain sans body go quite small.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-old-nor: Dense, tong-tipped lowercase: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs its letters into a tall band. Conthrax, meanwhile, does its best work as a geometric heading with zero modulation, leaving the sans to handle the reading.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-old-tur: Clean is Conthrax: every stroke ends at a measured thickness. Noto Sans Old Turkic adds clear, open-mouthed curves in chunky tall lowercase, so the plain sans body lets the heading lead.
